name: scroll-area
title: Minecraft Scroll Area
description: Java 26.2 vertical scrollbar and borderless clipped viewport with original scroller textures and native integer thumb geometry. Radix viewport preserves native browser scrolling; refs, custom ScrollBar and asChild composition supported. 297 repeatable native cases at scales1–3. Horizontal and hover-only variants are unsupported.
